description: Angular component for configuring doughnut chart widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, extending a base chart settings component and managing form controls and validation logic.

classes.name: DoughnutWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for doughnut chart widget settings, extending LatestChartWidgetSettingsComponent with specific controls and validation logic.

methods.name: defaultLatestChartSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the doughnut chart widget.

methods.name: latestChartConfigTemplate
methods.description: Provides the template reference for the doughnut chart configuration.

methods.name: setupLatestChartControls
methods.description: Initializes form controls for chart settings such as layout, autoScale, clockwise, totalValueFont, totalValueColor.

methods.name: latestChartValidatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns the list of form control names that trigger validation, here 'layout'.

methods.name: updateLatestChartValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the selected layout, specifically toggling total value font/color and legend display.
